home.subtitle: A lightweight collection of Ethereum / blockchain utilities that run entirely offline in your browser.

ethMnemonic.name: ETH Mnemonic Generator
ethMnemonic.description: Generate 12/24-word BIP-39 mnemonics locally and derive private keys and Ethereum addresses per BIP-44. Your data never leaves the browser.
ethMnemonic.subtitle: Generate a BIP-39 mnemonic locally and derive an Ethereum private key and address per the BIP-44 standard.
ethMnemonic.privacyNotice: All computations run locally in your browser. No network requests are made — your mnemonic and private key never leave your device
ethMnemonic.securityWarning: Your mnemonic is your assets. Never share it with anyone. Mnemonics generated here should only be used for learning / testing

abiInteractor.name: ABI Interactor
abiInteractor.description: Interact with any contract via its ABI — read state or send transactions through your wallet. Supports 25+ built-in networks and custom RPC endpoints.
abiInteractor.subtitle: Call read/write functions of any contract by providing its ABI. Connect an EIP-6963 wallet to send write transactions.
abiInteractor.privacyNotice: Read calls and ABI parsing run locally in your browser. RPC requests go directly to the endpoint you select — no intermediary server is involved

aaAddressCalculator.name: Smart Account Calculator
aaAddressCalculator.description: Calculate ERC-4337 smart account (AA) addresses locally using CREATE2. Support SimpleAccount, Safe, Coinbase, Alchemy, Kernel, Biconomy and more.
aaAddressCalculator.subtitle: Compute counterfactual addresses for ERC-4337 smart accounts across multiple wallet brands. All calculations run locally.
aaAddressCalculator.privacyNotice: Address calculation runs entirely in your browser. On-chain queries (deployment check, owner lookup) send read-only requests to public RPC endpoints — no sensitive data is transmitted
